description: Curated high-quality free learning resources mapped to technical skills (#885).

Python.title: The Python Tutorial (Official Docs)
Python.review_note: Comprehensive official reference covering standard types, flow control, modules, and data structures.

Python.title: Scientific Computing with Python
Python.review_note: Hands-on browser-based exercises building practical algorithms, budget trackers, and arithmetic formatters.

Python.title: Python OOP & Core Concepts Playlist
Python.review_note: Crystal-clear explanations of object-oriented Python, decorators, generators, and dunder methods.

JavaScript.title: The Modern JavaScript Tutorial
JavaScript.review_note: The gold standard for modern ES6+ concepts, event loop mechanics, closures, and DOM manipulation.

JavaScript.title: MDN JavaScript Learning Pathway
JavaScript.review_note: Authoritative MDN guides with interactive code editors explaining variables, async code, and APIs.

TypeScript.title: The TypeScript Handbook
TypeScript.review_note: Official guide explaining type narrowing, generics, utility types, and strict mode best practices.

TypeScript.title: Total TypeScript Beginner's Tutorial
TypeScript.review_note: Interactive code challenges resolving real-world compiler errors and type inference puzzles.

React.title: React Official Documentation & Quick Start
React.review_note: Modern documentation focusing on functional components, custom hooks, state preservation, and effects.

React.title: React 18 Full Course for Beginners
React.review_note: Project-based curriculum building interactive single-page applications from scratch.

Docker.title: Docker Getting Started Guide
Docker.review_note: Official hands-on walkthrough covering containerization, Dockerfiles, volume mounts, and Compose.

Docker.title: The Docker Handbook
Docker.review_note: Practical visual guide to building, inspecting, running, and publishing containerized applications.

Kubernetes.title: Kubernetes Official Interactive Basics
Kubernetes.review_note: Browser-based Katacoda pods exploring cluster creation, deployments, scaling, and rolling updates.

Kubernetes.title: Kubernetes Course for Beginners
Kubernetes.review_note: Comprehensive visual breakdown of Pods, Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps, and PersistentVolumes.

SQL.title: SQLBolt - Interactive SQL Lessons
SQL.review_note: Interactive browser exercises teaching SELECT, JOINs, aggregations, constraints, and schema changes.

SQL.title: Mode Analytics SQL Tutorial
SQL.review_note: Industry-focused SQL lessons covering window functions, subqueries, and analytical data queries.

PostgreSQL.title: PostgreSQL Tutorial for Beginners
PostgreSQL.review_note: Step-by-step guides covering indexing, query optimization, JSONB fields, transactions, and triggers.

Git.title: Flight Rules for Git
Git.review_note: Essential practical guide to recovering from mistakes, rebase workflows, and branch management.

Git.title: Learn Git Branching
Git.review_note: Visual tree-based sandbox to master rebase, cherry-pick, merge, and commit navigation.

Data Structures & Algorithms.title: NeetCode DSA Roadmap & Explanations
Data Structures & Algorithms.review_note: Curated pattern-oriented learning tree covering sliding windows, two pointers, trees, and graphs.

Data Structures & Algorithms.title: VisuAlgo - Algorithm Visualizer
Data Structures & Algorithms.review_note: Interactive step-through animations for sorting, graph traversals, segment trees, and hash tables.

System Design.title: The System Design Primer
System Design.review_note: The definitive open-source guide to scalability, load balancing, caching, databases, and microservices.

Linux.title: Linux Journey
Linux.review_note: Bite-sized modules explaining shell commands, filesystem hierarchy, permissions, processes, and packages.

AWS.title: AWS Cloud Essentials Learning Plan
AWS.review_note: Free foundational digital curriculum and game-based exercises directly from Amazon Web Services.

Redis.title: RU101: Introduction to Redis Data Structures
Redis.review_note: Official course on Redis key-value storage, sets, hashes, TTL expiration, and caching patterns.
